title: Relaxing Creekview Guest Suite w/ Kitchen & Grill
description:
Welcome to Creekview!  

Enjoy this private guest suite conveniently located 15 miles from Nashville and near several local shopping districts, historic sights, and natural wonders. 

This farmhouse-style suite includes free parking, full kitchen, queen-sized bed, roomy entertainment area, flat screen television, and spacious spa shower.  Outside you can also enjoy our pool (open late May-September), BBQ grill, alfresco dining area, and vast lawn leading to our signature creekside views.

The space
This clean, spacious unit is decorated in a cozy farmhouse style with many touches centered around our home state of Tennessee.

Guest access
This unit includes a private entry, bedroom, bathroom, full kitchen, and living room. Outside the guests can enjoy a pool (open seasonally), outdoor dining area, BBQ grill, fire pit, and access to a relaxing creek. Pets under 25lbs allowed with pet fee.

Other things to note
Pet fee is $66 with a maximum of 2 pets that must be less than 25 lbs. ONLY one (1) pet over 25 lbs. is allowed and not to exceed 75 lbs. 
Pet bathroom area is outside the gate anywhere in the backyard. No walking pets in pool area. No pets in pool.
